items.title: North Korea gets closer to China and Russia with new bridges
items.description: Increasing trade and co-operation reduces need for talks with Washington and Seoul, analysts say

items.title: Oil hits five-month high of $110 on new escalation in Middle East
items.description: Brent prices jump on reports that Saudi Arabia-led forces intercepted and destroyed missiles aimed at critical energy hubs

items.title: Healey says new Heathrow runway would boost ‘growth’ despite Burnham wavering
items.description: Future of £33bn project has been put in doubt since new prime minister took office

items.title: Big Tech stocks suffer biggest weekly drop since ‘liberation day’
items.description: AI trade jitters send investors scrambling for government debt in a move that halts a months-long Treasury sell-off

items.title: Italy secures EU deal to lower its electricity prices
items.description: Agreement marks a boost for PM Giorgia Meloni as nation struggles with higher fossil fuel prices

items.title: Rich make millions by flipping private jets
items.description: Strong demand for private air travel combined with production delays boosts prices

items.title: M.L.B. Playoff Ads With Sydney Sweeney and Megan Fox Draw Backlash
items.description: Commercials with Sydney Sweeney promoting a gambling platform and Megan Fox endorsing male enhancement have rankled fans, and even athletes. Who is in charge?

items.title: Netflix Hurries to Rewrite Its Narrative With Layoffs and a Sudden Firing
items.description: Despite strong revenues and profits, the streaming service cut 1,000 jobs and jettisoned its chief content officer. Drops in the stock price and viewer engagement are to blame.

items.title: U.S. Budget Deficit Nears $2 Trillion, a Reality Check for Trump’s Cost Cutting
items.description: Higher interest rates are inflating borrowing costs as the Trump administration spends on the Iran war and tariff refunds.

items.title: You’ve Found a Long-Lost CD. Can You Still Get Your Money?
items.description: The bank was required to hold the certificate of deposit only for a limited time, and now has no record of the money. Experts offer tips to avoid having this happen to you.

items.title: When Will the Fed Move on Rates?
items.description: Kevin Warsh, the central bank’s chairman, suggested he wouldn’t push to raise borrowing rates this month. But persistent inflation may force the Fed’s hand.

items.title: Indonesian Stocks Plunge as MSCI Threatens to Drop Market from Indexes
items.description: The potential downgrade by MSCI, an influential index provider, adds to a deepening crisis of investor confidence in the economic policies of President Prabowo Subianto.

items.title: Feel Like You’re Overpaying for Hotels? Blame Expedia, a New Lawsuit Says.
items.description: The booking giant is accused of breaking federal antitrust laws and forcing millions of customers to overspend on stays by as much as 30 percent.

items.title: Lufthansa’s Final A346 Flight Marks the End of an Aviation Love Story
items.description: Lufthansa’s quirky plane, with its extra-long fuselage, four engines and restrooms down a flight of stairs, has a devoted following. Now, the carrier, one of few still flying the model, is taking it out of service.
